perspective_summary: Formalize the question as a conditional-information test, not as an efficacy or novelty claim. For patient p and episode e, the directional hypothesis is H_state: the legal intent label Y_pe is not conditionally independent of the patient-excluded current state M_p given the identical signed scribble S_pe, cue geometry G_pe, image/context channels X_p, and frozen episode protocol. Its strongest alternative is H_cue: Y_pe is conditionally independent of M_p once S_pe, G_pe, X_p, and the protocol are known, so the full and no_M0 arms have equal patient-level generalization risk apart from sampling variation. The frozen full-versus-no_M0 comparison can distinguish these only if every M0-derived path is removed from no_M0, all other inputs and training choices are matched, and inference is performed at patient level. Because scribble sign is constructed from FN/FP residual type, operation prediction alone is not distinguishing evidence; the informative locus must include joint intent and the target/scope slots conditional on the same cue. This contribution specifies a testable interface and gates, but selects no replacement model and asserts no result.

observations.statement: Use indices p for patient, c for case, e for episode, and v for voxel. Let X_pc denote the frozen image/context inputs; M_pc^OOF(v) the exactly-one patient-excluded upstream current-state prediction; S_pce(v) in {-1, 0, +1} the signed scribble field; G_pce the frozen cue-geometry vector; A_pce the declared state/cue support masks; and Y_pce=(O,T,Q) the intent label with operation O, target T, and scope Q. Ground truth may construct the residual-derived scribble and label under the frozen protocol but is not an inference-time channel.

Primary hypothesis H_state: I(Y; M^OOF | X,S,G,protocol) > 0 for the locked episode distribution, equivalently there exists a prespecified proper joint loss for which the patient-averaged risk of the frozen full arm is lower than that of the matched no_M0 arm. This is an unverified hypothesis, not a claimed effect.

Strongest alternative H_cue: I(Y; M^OOF | X,S,G,protocol) = 0. Under this alternative, signed cue polarity, cue geometry, image context, and episode-construction regularities contain all predictive information available to the frozen interface; adding M0 cannot improve held-out patient-level risk beyond sampling variation.

Scribble construction is downstream of residual type: FN residuals yield positive ADD cues and FP residuals yield negative REMOVE cues. Therefore sign can be a near-direct operation cue and also carries indirect information about the relation to M0. A full-arm gain confined to operation does not isolate state-dependent interpretation; the distinguishing analysis must report the joint label and the target/scope components on identical episodes.

The output domain is the six-element legal set L={ADD_SAME_LOCAL, REMOVE_SAME_LOCAL, ADD_SAME_COMPLETE, REMOVE_SAME_COMPLETE, ADD_NEW_COMPLETE, REMOVE_NEW_COMPLETE}, together with the frozen operation, target, and scope heads. NEW_LOCAL is structurally illegal and must never be counted as an observed legal class.

The estimand must be patient-level. Define L_p^a as the mean prespecified joint loss across all eligible locked episodes for patient p under arm a, then Delta_p=L_p^no_M0-L_p^full and Delta=(1/P) sum_p Delta_p. Confidence intervals or randomization/bootstrap units must be patients, never episodes or voxels; all episodes from one patient remain in one split and one resampling unit.

A valid no_M0 arm requires a closed provenance inventory of every direct and derived M0 path, including state channels, state-support masks, cached features, episode metadata, filenames, sampling strata, and normalization statistics. It must also exclude ground-truth residual maps, post-edit states, and patient/case identifiers. Otherwise Delta measures leakage or implementation mismatch rather than conditional state information.

The first operational blocker is exact downstream deployed-bundle and F0 closure after the stale-bundle failure. The committed 597-case, 378-patient OOF M0 set is an immutable upstream input and must not be rerun as a response to that failure.

Cross-attention belongs only in a deferred, separately registered ablation or future-work stage after the simple 17-channel primary and its full-versus-no_M0 contrast are executed and interpreted. It cannot replace, rescue, or retrospectively redefine the current primary.

No empirical feasibility, training, inference, metric, effect estimate, comparator result, or publication conclusion currently exists for the v2 six-class P2T/editor system. All equations and expected directions here are preregistration-level objects only.

proposed_mechanisms.description: State-conditioned signed-cue interpretation through the already frozen simple-primary interface. This is an interface formalization of the existing 17-channel state/cue primary, not selection of a new model. The mechanism asks whether the same cue has different intent meaning relative to the current state, while preserving the legal ontology and component heads.
inputs: Canonical frozen 17-channel episode tensor Z_pce, with its exact channel map supplied and hashed by F0 closure
Patient-excluded current state M_pc^OOF and an exhaustive manifest of every channel or support function derived from it
Signed scribble S_pce and cue-support mask, identical in full and no_M0
Frozen geometry vector G_pce, identical in full and no_M0
Legal training label Y_pce=(O,T,Q) in L; label and ground truth are unavailable as inference inputs
proposed_mechanisms.transformation: Let H_pce=F_theta(Z_pce) be features from the unchanged frozen backbone. Apply the already specified state-support and cue-support pooling operators to obtain u_state and u_cue, map G_pce through the frozen geometry transformation u_geo, concatenate h=[u_state,u_cue,u_geo], and expose the frozen joint/operation/target/scope heads. The joint output q_joint ranges over L and component outputs q_O, q_T, q_Q follow the three slots. In the full arm, declared M0-derived state paths are active. In no_M0, exactly those paths are replaced by the registered noninformative values or masks while tensor shape, pooling code, all non-M0 channels, and episode identity remain unchanged. This makes the arm indicator intervene only on access to M0-derived information; it does not alter the scribble, geometry, split, or label.
proposed_mechanisms.expected_signal: For a prespecified proper joint loss ell, compute Delta_p=mean_e[ell(q_no_M0,Y)-ell(q_full,Y)] and summarize Delta across held-out patients. H_state predicts positive patient-level Delta, with corresponding prespecified target and/or scope improvement conditional on identical cues; an operation-only difference is not sufficient because polarity already encodes ADD versus REMOVE. H_cue predicts Delta=0 in expectation. No numerical magnitude or positive result is asserted.
proposed_mechanisms.failure_mode: The contrast is uninterpretable if any M0-derived data remain in no_M0; if ground truth, residual magnitude, post-edit state, patient identity, or episode-generation metadata leak into either arm; if arm-specific preprocessing, sampling, initialization, optimization, or stopping differs; if train/test patients overlap; if repeated episodes are treated as independent patients; or if legal-joint coverage is too sparse to support the preregistered patient-level analysis. Cue sign completely determining the scored target would also collapse the intended distinction into a construction shortcut.

experiments.comparison: Minimum locked comparison: the frozen simple-primary full arm versus its frozen no_M0 ablation on exactly the same controlled and natural episodes. Full receives the declared M0-derived state channels/supports; no_M0 neutralizes only those declared paths. The already frozen polarity-blind and geometry-only arms may diagnose shortcuts but are not substitutes for this primary pair and add no new arm to the matrix.
held_constant: Patient-level train/validation/test split and the committed patient-excluded OOF M0 files; no OOF rerun
Case and episode identities, signed scribble masks, scribble construction seed, polarity, cue geometry, labels, controlled/natural episode mix, and sampling weights
Canonical 17-channel contract except for the registered neutralization of M0-derived paths in no_M0
Backbone, pooling and head code, parameter-budget policy, initialization seeds, minibatch order, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, regularization, early-stopping rule, and total training budget

Checkpoint-selection rule, joint/component metrics, legal-class handling, patient aggregation, confidence-interval procedure, smallest relevant effect if used, and stop/falsification thresholds, all frozen before outcomes are inspected
experiments.observable: Primary observable: paired held-out patient values Delta_p=L_p^no_M0-L_p^full for the prespecified joint loss, with Delta and its patient-level confidence interval. Report patient-level joint accuracy/error and target/scope component contrasts as interpretable diagnostics, operation as a polarity-shortcut check, per-legal-joint patient support, and controlled versus natural episode slices without promoting a slice to a new primary. Required leakage checks are zero patient/case overlap; one patient-excluded M0 provenance record per eligible case; identical episode hashes across arms; no ground-truth/residual/post-edit input path; no M0-derived path in no_M0; and no arm-revealing filenames, caches, statistics, or sampler differences.
experiments.falsifier: After bundle/F0, coverage, and leakage gates pass, the directional H_state claim is falsified for this frozen interface if the prespecified patient-level 95% upper confidence bound for Delta is <=0 on the locked held-out set. A practically meaningful version also fails if that upper bound is below a nonzero smallest relevant effect fixed before unblinding. In either case, stop escalation of the state-dependence claim and do not introduce cross-attention as a rescue. Before fitting, stop the experiment if exact downstream bundle/F0 hashes cannot be closed, if any legal joint has zero eligible held-out patients or misses the preregistered minimum patient-support gate in the FN/FP atlas, or if any leakage check fails; none of these stops authorizes an OOF M0 rerun.

blockers: BLOCKER-1 (first operational): reproduce and hash the exact downstream software bundle, environment, configuration, and F0 contract after the stale deployed-bundle failure. Until closure, do not start M0 evaluation or downstream fitting, and do not rerun the committed OOF M0 set.

BLOCKER-2 (scientific coverage gate): build the FN/FP atlas and freeze patient-support thresholds for all six legal joints before claiming six-class feasibility. Zero or sub-threshold support triggers the prespecified stop rather than label merging or post hoc resampling.

BLOCKER-3 (contrast validity): freeze and audit the exhaustive M0-derived-path manifest, identical episode hashes, patient-exclusive split, patient-level estimand, loss/metric, confidence procedure, and smallest relevant effect before outcome access.
